pluss::subsp::stats::ts::vecm_to_var¶

Converts the short-run and impact matrices of an error-correction model into VAR lag matrices.

Signature¶

pluss::Series ts::vecm_to_var(const pluss::Series& short_run, const pluss::Series& impact, pluss::codem::Config cfg = {});

What It Does¶

The inverse of var_to_vecm: with Π the impact and Γ_i the short-run matrices, the lag matrices are A_1 = I + Π + Γ_1, A_i = Γ_i − Γ_{i−1} for 1 < i < p, and A_p = −Γ_{p−1}.

Parameters¶

const pluss::Series& short_run

The short-run matrices, (p − 1) × k × k (empty first dimension for p = 1).

const pluss::Series& impact

The impact matrix, k × k.

pluss::codem::Config cfg

Output configuration (dtype and platform of the returned series).

Returns¶

The lag matrices, p × k × k.

Practical Examples¶

Example 1¶

A VECM’s matrices expressed as a VAR: with no short-run terms the lag array is a single matrix I + impact.

#include <pluss/ma.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

namespace ts = pluss::subsp::stats::ts;
using pluss::Series;

const auto f64 = pluss::Config{}.with_dtype(pluss::ScalarType::Float64);
void show(const char* label, const Series& s) {
  std::cout << std::left << std::setw(14) << label << std::right << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4);
  for (double v : s.host<double>()) std::cout << std::setw(9) << v;
  std::cout << "\n";
}
std::vector<double> noise(int n, int offset) {
  std::vector<double> e(n);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    double u = std::sin(12.9898 * (i + offset + 1.0) + 78.233) * 43758.5453;
    u -= std::floor(u);
    e[i] = u - 0.5;
  }
  return e;
}
// Three series: x is a random walk, y = x + a stationary AR(1) (so y is tied to x), w is an unrelated random walk.
Series three(int n) {
  const auto e1 = noise(n, 0), e2 = noise(n, 5000), e3 = noise(n, 9000);
  std::vector<double> y(3 * n);
  double x = 0.0, u = 0.0, w = 0.0;
  for (int t = 0; t < n; ++t) {
    x += e1[t];
    u = 0.6 * u + e2[t];
    w += e3[t];
    y[3 * t] = x;
    y[3 * t + 1] = x + u;
    y[3 * t + 2] = w;
  }
  return pluss::make_series(y, {n, 3}, f64);
}

int main() {
  const Series y = three(400);
  ts::VecmOptions options;
  options.rank = 1;
  const auto fit = ts::Vecm::fit_mle(y, options);
  const Series ar = ts::vecm_to_var(fit.gamma, fit.impact);
  std::cout << "lag array shape: " << ar.sizes()[0] << " x " << ar.sizes()[1] << " x " << ar.sizes()[2] << "\n";
  std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4) << "(A_1 - I) minus impact, largest absolute entry: " << (ar.select(0, 0) - pluss::series::eye(3, 3).to(pluss::ScalarType::Float64) - fit.impact).abs().max().item<double>() << "\n";
}

Output

lag array shape: 1 x 3 x 3
(A_1 - I) minus impact, largest absolute entry: 0.0000
